capabilities: embed interactive chess boards in notes via chess code blocks
play positions against a bundled offline Stockfish engine
study built-in openings, endgame techniques, and World Championship games
import Lichess games into review notes with stats and a performance dashboard
annotate boards with arrows, highlights, and an opening explorer
extras: Two piece sets (staunty, caliente) carry a CC BY-NC-SA non-commercial restriction; README notes forkers selling the plugin should remove them.
problem: Obsidian has no way to render, annotate, or interact with chess positions, games, and openings inside notes.

relations.evidence: Requires the community plugin Claudian (realclaudian) and a Chessology skill file
Pull a Lichess game directly with lichess: <url> — no token needed

summary: A chess study plugin that embeds interactive boards in notes via chess code blocks, plays against an offline Stockfish, and tracks Lichess game reviews.
